description: Source code for a firmware image builder utility, including functions for reading files, constructing firmware headers, and writing output files, with board-specific configurations.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board configuration based on its ID.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the utility.

methods.name: read_to_buf
methods.description: Reads file contents into a buffer.

methods.name: check_options
methods.description: Validates command-line options and file sizes.

methods.name: write_fw
methods.description: Writes the constructed firmware data to output file.

methods.name: build_fw
methods.description: Builds the firmware image with headers, data, and CRCs.
